WITH centromea_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    CENTROMEA,
    AVG(CASE WHEN GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL THEN GOT - GPT ELSE NULL END) as avg_ast_minus_alt,
    AVG(CASE WHEN APPT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APPT - PT ELSE NULL END) as avg_appt_minus_pt
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE WBC > 6.5
  GROUP BY CENTROMEA
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ast_minus_alt) as avg_of_avg_ast_minus_alt,
  AVG(avg_appt_minus_pt) as avg_of_avg_appt_minus_pt
FROM centromea_groups
